title: Replace Zendesk With a Custom Support Tool Built in a Weekend
summary: Replace Zendesk's $55/agent/month pricing with a custom support tool you build in a weekend. No per-seat fees, full control, database and auth included.
body_markdown: Build a simple SLA timer into the ticket data model: a target_resolution_at timestamp calculated from ticket creation time and priority level. The dashboard highlights tickets approaching or past their SLA. This covers 90% of what teams use SLA management for. Zendesk's SLA analytics suite covers more edge cases — if you're running a large contact center with complex SLA contracts, the enterprise tool is probably worth it.
